description: Guidance for generating SQL injection validation strategies focused on response-shape comparison, not data extraction.
consider: parameter data type and location (query string vs JSON body field)
baseline status code and response length
whether the endpoint is authentication-related (higher impact, same test discipline)
references: OWASP Web Security Testing Guide - Testing for SQL Injection
CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command
example_patterns: a trailing single quote to look for a broken/escaped-quote response-shape difference
a true-vs-false boolean pair compared against the recorded baseline, not against each other alone
